bullets.title: NVDA: OpenAI data center guarantee cut to <$120B from $250B; $3B SB Energy stake in talks
bullets.body: NVIDIA is reworking its financial backstop for the OpenAI Ohio data center campus from $250B to under $120B (possibly ~$100B), limiting balance-sheet risk while a separate $350B chip-financing deal remains under discussion. NVIDIA is also reportedly in talks to invest $3B in SB Energy, the project developer. Additionally, NVIDIA's Q2 13F disclosed a $21B stake in SpaceX and a new COHR position alongside increased CRWV and NBIS holdings.

bullets.title: AMZN: MS raises PT to $335; AWS path to $1T revenue by 2034-36 with 80-100% upside
bullets.body: Morgan Stanley raises AMZN PT to $335 (Overweight) with a bull case of ~$500/share by YE2027, premised on AWS reaching $1T revenue by 2034-36 assuming 8 GW/year capacity additions and $12-15/watt monetization. AWS currently monetizes at $8/incremental watt; $1T scenario implies ~$300B AWS EBIT and $500B company-wide EBIT, with shares trading at a ~50% discount to hyperscaler peers.

bullets.title: Anthropic revenue surge ($11.5B Q2, 14x YoY) validates AI infrastructure bull thesis
bullets.body: Anthropic reported Q2 2026 revenue of $11.5B+ (up ~14-fold YoY) and projects 2028 revenue of $190-200B, well above the $47B run rate cited in May. The company posted its second straight quarter of positive adjusted operating income. OpenAI enterprise revenue now exceeds consumer, with a $40B annualized run rate and 20%+ MoM growth in July. These data points drove broad strength across memory (SNDK +4-5%, MU +3%, WDC +4%, STX +2%) and AI infrastructure names.

bullets.title: MRVL: UBS raises estimates ahead of earnings; Blackwell/Rubin ramp driving upside
bullets.body: UBS raises MRVL July Q estimates to $2.76B/$0.94 (from $2.70B/$0.91) and Sep Q to $3.07B/$1.08, benefiting from Blackwell strength and accelerating Rubin ramp. Microsoft Maia 300 program could exceed 1M units adding $1-2B incremental demand; CXL attach at Google gaining momentum with ASPs >$1,000/chip. UBS maintains Buy at $300 PT (trimmed from $340) on custom silicon and optical connectivity themes.

bullets.title: SNDK: Strong 2030 financial targets drive +35% week; 80% adj. gross margins projected
bullets.body: SanDisk rallied ~35% last week on new financial targets through 2030: ~80% adjusted gross margins, ~75% operating margins, ~50% adj. FCF margins, with LTAs already covering 2/3 of 2028 output and $93B minimum contracted revenue. Phison CEO separately warns 2027 NAND capacity constraints will be even more severe than 2026, supporting elevated pricing for years. Opco notes SNDK underestimates TAM from persistent/long-horizon agent memory.

bullets.title: NOK: Jefferies initiates Buy at €13.80 (59% upside) on AI datacenter optical share gains
bullets.body: Jefferies initiates Nokia at Buy with a €13.80 PT, citing a €6.2B Cloud & AI backlog (>€4B unrecognized), San Jose fab capacity expanding 20x and Pennsylvania fab 10x in H2-26, and recently won 800G coherent pluggable contracts with two hyperscalers (likely Meta and Google). Optical+IP segment expected to grow >30% in 2027-28, rising from 26% to 40% of revenue by 2027, with EPS growing at ~25% CAGR 2026-28.

bullets.title: WDAY: Dual downgrades (BTIG to Neutral, Deutsche Bank to Hold) on Silver Lake deal skepticism
bullets.body: WDAY downgraded to Neutral at BTIG and to Hold at Deutsche Bank (PT raised to $220 from $180), both citing concerns about Silver Lake acquisition chatter. UBS maintains Neutral ($220 PT) noting the deal faces tight credit markets, founder's AI-focused mission, and materially higher stock price (~$200 vs $115-130 when discussions allegedly began. Software M&A speculation nonetheless boosted the broader SaaS group.

bullets.title: AAPL: Upgraded to Buy at Rothschild ($400 PT, 31% upside); White House pushes back on Chinese memory
bullets.body: Rothschild & Co Redburn upgrades AAPL to Buy from Neutral, raising PT to $400 from $260. Separately, the White House/Commerce Secretary Lutnick explicitly urged Apple not to source memory chips from Chinese companies (CXMT, YMTC), a potential supply-chain disruption. Apple is also reportedly building a China-specific AI model with Alibaba support for Apple Intelligence rollout, and the foldable iPhone 18 PM announcement is expected September 9.

bullets.title: SHOP/RDDT: SHOP downgraded at Phillip Securities; RDDT jumps 10%+ on S&P 500 inclusion
bullets.body: Shopify downgraded to Accumulate from Buy at Phillip Securities (PT raised to $170); in broader internet earnings context, SHOP had already rallied +17% on Q2 GMV beat. Reddit added to S&P 500 effective Aug 18 with gross indexer demand of 16.7M shares; stock rose ~10% last week. APP downgraded to Neutral at JPM on execution concerns.

bullets.title: ALAB: Northland upgrade drives +5.1% pre-market; AI infrastructure read-throughs positive
bullets.body: ALAB was upgraded by Northland Capital and rose 5.1% in pre-market trading. JPMorgan separately raised Alchip (Trainium 3/4 ramp + Google TPU optionality) FY27/28 EPS by +3%/+16%. Broader AI infrastructure stocks accounted for ~half of S&P 500's 31% YoY EPS growth in Q2 2026, per Goldman Sachs.

bullets.title: ETSY: Goldman reinstates at Neutral with $89 PT post-Depop; investors question reacceleration
bullets.body: Goldman Sachs reinstated ETSY at Neutral with an $89 PT (~11% upside from $79.90), noting a simpler marketplace post-Depop divestiture but flagging investor skepticism around growth reacceleration and margin expansion. Separately an Intrinsic Value Podcast noted ETSY remains a 'too hard' category for them.

bullets.title: INTU: Mizuho cuts PT to $430 (from $500) ahead of F4Q26 reset; trough valuation near 13x P/E
bullets.body: Mizuho reiterates Outperform on INTU but cuts PT to $430, expecting management to embed conservatism into FY27 revenue guide (models +9.8% vs consensus +11.7%). TurboTax Live now 53% of tax segment revenue; trough valuation at ~13x FY27E non-GAAP P/E seen as a credibility-rebuilding clearing event ahead of September Investor Day.

bullets.title: AXTI: InP substrate prices surging (largest price hike ever) on severe AI optical demand shortage
bullets.body: Multiple sources confirm AXTI's Indium Phosphide substrates are experiencing the largest price hike on record, with material unavailable regardless of buyer's ability to pay as AI-driven optical communications demand creates a severe shortage. Q4 2026 prices set to jump 10%+. AXTI shares up strongly on the news.

bullets.title: COHR/LITE/NOK/CIEN: DCI port scaling to 20-40M by 2030 creates $100B+ optical opportunity
bullets.body: An investor note highlights DCI ports scaling from <1M today to 20-40M by end of decade, a $100B+ market with ~30% of links stretching 100km+, driving demand for coherent optics and routing gear. CIEN, NOK, COHR, and LITE all identified as beneficiaries. Separately, investors are pressing COHR to publish UHP laser linewidth data or run a convincing demo at ECOC/OCP to validate CPO credentials; Nvidia's Q2 13F disclosed new COHR and increased CRWV positions.

bullets.title: BABA: Qwen models hit 3B+ downloads (#1 globally); gaming unit sold for $1.5B; earnings Aug 20
bullets.body: Alibaba's open-weight Qwen models accumulated 3B+ global downloads in six months, surpassing Meta and Alphabet to become the world's most-downloaded AI model. BABA is selling its gaming unit Lingxi Games to Trustar Capital for $1.5B+ as part of its AI pivot. BABA reports 2Q earnings Aug 20; Jefferies group call on Chinese internet Aug 20.

bullets.title: TSLA: FSD handles 95% of Uber driver trips; Model Y #1 in China midsize SUV but market share at all-time low
bullets.body: A real-world Uber driver reports FSD beta handles 95% of trip distance, boosting safety score from 70% to 98%. However, Tesla Model Y's trailing 3-month China market share fell to an all-time low of 8%, losing half its market share in 26 months amid intense EV competition.

bullets.title: PSKY/CMCSA: Box office rebounds 76.5% YoY to $160M; IMAX China opening $13.2M for The Odyssey
bullets.body: The US/Canada weekend box office surged 76.5% YoY to $160.2M, with Spider-Man ($70M) leading and The Odyssey (CMCSA, $23.2M) and PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie (PSKY, $20.5M) contributing. IMAX reported CNY90M ($13.2M) China opening weekend for The Odyssey, which has grossed $345M in IMAX format worldwide.

bullets.title: IREN: Duquesne 13F discloses new stake; institutions accumulating vs. retail selling
bullets.body: IREN rallied on disclosure of a Duquesne 13F stake. Social commentary notes a prominent macro investor known for a $1B+ GBP short also initiated a position in IREN, while institutional accumulation has been occurring against retail panic-selling. NBIS had its best week in ~2 years post-earnings with all metrics beating.

bullets.title: GOOGL: Berkshire adds 48.1M shares (now $36-37B, 3rd largest position); plans AUD bond offering
bullets.body: Berkshire Hathaway boosted its Alphabet stake by 48.1M shares in Q2, making GOOGL its third-largest position at ~$36-37B. Multiple other major funds (Druckenmiller, Li Lu allocating ~50% of portfolio, Altimeter initiating, Third Point) also added GOOGL in Q2. Alphabet separately plans an A$5B Australian dollar bond offering to fund AI infrastructure capital needs.

bullets.title: TTWO: Piper bullish on GTA 6 Netflix tie-in; 35-45M launch units expected
bullets.body: Piper Sandler's morning note flags TTWO's GTA 6 marketing cadence is quieter than prior launches but views the Netflix partnership as incremental; expert consensus pegs launch units at 35-45M. Piper also initiates SOFI at Overweight ($22 PT, 20% upside) modeling 22% revenue CAGR and 27% adj. EBITDA CAGR 2026-28, and DAVE at Overweight ($390 PT, 17% upside).
